content: Information on text structure, typography, and images can also be leveraged as part of a neural machine translation approach to text simplification. A set of parallel documents used in machine translation additionally requires sentence alignments, which are still missing from our corpus. Hence, as a next step, we will include such information using the Customized Alignment for Text Simplification (CATS) tool BIBREF23.
